svg.title: Swell bending round a headland
svg.desc: Plan view of a made-up headland with swell coming from the east-south-east, drawn twice. Each line is a wave crest. Over deep water the crests are straight; as the seabed shallows they slow and turn to face the shore. Both wrap round the point, but the 14-second groundswell feels the bottom further out and bends more, so in the bay its crests run almost along the beach while the 8-second wind swell's still come in at an angle.
